description: How OneAI reads what arrives in this workspace.

fields.label: Read Files Attached to Records
fields.description: Scans and photos attached on a form are read too, on behalf of whoever attached them.

fields.label: Most Pages Read
fields.description: A longer scan is read up to this page and found by its name beyond it.

fields.label: Confidence Floor
fields.description: Below this, OneAI's changes wait in Needs Review.

fields.label: Audit OneAI Actions
fields.description: If enabled, a second check approves what OneAI did with each document or sends it to a person.

fields.label: Leave Unmatched Files in Place
fields.description: If enabled, files that match no record stay where they arrived.

fields.label: Quiet Minutes
fields.description: OneAI acts once a matter has been quiet this long, except on money or deadlines due within a day.

fields.label: Household
fields.description: If enabled, no drafts are made and Spending shows what was bought.

fields.label: Submit Matching E-Invoices
fields.description: If enabled, an e-invoice from a known supplier that matches its order is submitted.

name: Intake Settings
